quote: We propose SetGNER, a novel Entity Set Generation framework for general NER scenes.

Strict evaluation metrics is applied, where an entity is confirmed correct only if its boundary and type label are both recognized correctly. Precision (P), Recall (R) and Micro F1 score (F1) are reported in the results.
